reason: Vocational education (Berufspaedagogik) is not taught in any EMI module; timetable subject T113 Grundlagen der Berufspaedagogik und Didaktik has the main topic
E173 Stochastik (estimation, tests) and E032 Data Analytics (EDA, cleaning, predictive basics) cover about half to two thirds; regularisation, cross-validation, PCA/SVD and bootstrap are missing
E173 Stochastik teaches random variables, distributions, expectation, variance, estimation and hypothesis tests at the same level
Numerical field simulation (FDM, FEM, BEM, numerical linear algebra) is in no EMI module; E165 is MATLAB/Simulink system simulation, not field methods
Lab work on dimensioning and characterising electronic circuits matches the Praktikum parts of E046 and E047 Elektronische Bauelemente und Schaltungstechnik 1/2
Cost accounting and controlling appear only as list items in E019 Betriebswirtschaftliche Grundlagen; no EMI module has this main topic
E129 Mobile and Ubiquitous Computing covers mobile platforms (Android), IoT boards, RFID/NFC, sensors and IoT protocols
Graph theory is only one bullet (Elemente der Graphentheorie) in E117 Mathematik 2 and graphs a data structure in E002; flows, matchings, colourings not taught
E091 Informationssicherheit covers threat models and ISO 27001 but no risk frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST, FAIR) or risk quantification
E125 Medienlehre und Mediengestaltung covers film design (image, light, sound, montage) but not media history or interpretive film analysis
E102 KI Projekt Gaming is a team AI project with implementation and presentation; description of the 2-ECTS project is thin
E019 Betriebswirtschaftliche Grundlagen covers constitutive decisions, organisation, HR, innovation, production, marketing, accounting and finance; entrepreneurship part missing
E051 Elektrotechnik 3 (two-port theory) and E082 Hochfrequenztechnik (HF lines, matching, reflection) together; Smith chart and HF components partly missing
E080 Grundlagen elektrischer Maschinen und Antriebe teaches DC and three-phase machines and their operation
Clinical study design, survival data, sample size planning are not in E173 Stochastik or any EMI module; statistics counted as mathematics but domain is medical
E044 Elektrische Energietechnik covers distribution equipment, networks and short circuit but not switchgear selection and installation planning
E040 Digitaltechnik (VHDL synthesis on CPLD/FPGA) and E053 Embedded Systems (microcontrollers); HW/SW co-design and hardware signal processing missing
E166 Software Engineering 1 (team development, version control, requirements) and E167 Software Engineering 2 (Scrum, user stories, CI, unit tests); GitLab CI/CD and MongoDB missing
E171 SPS covers discrete control design (Ablaufsteuerungen) and E043 continuous systems, but automata, Petri nets and diagnosis of discrete-event systems are missing
E045 Elektrische Messtechnik covers measurement basics, error estimation, instruments, oscilloscopes, bridges, digital measurement and lab; sensor part missing
